messages:
maria_dev: Midday handoff — I'm out from ~13:00–17:00, leaving gpu watch for west region. Quick notes: dedicated-g1 at ~78% util, burst tokens ~22. Scheduled customer heavy batch at 14:30 (CUST-42-align). If queue latency >120ms or tokens drop <10, either escalate or toggle fallback routing to fallback-pool. Runbook: <https://go/runbooks/gpu-burst>

sam_oncall: got it. I'll keep an eye. Can you paste the prometheus queries you use for quick checks? also, any non-critical background jobs we can pause? :pray:

maria_dev: sure — quick metrics I check:
```
# GPUs allocated in pool
sum(gpu_allocated{pool="dedicated-g1"})
# avg request latency over 1m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le))
# burst tokens remaining
redwood_burst_tokens{pool="dedicated-g1"}
```
Non-critical: nightly-embeddings-retry and async-eval-worker — can throttle to 0.2x for the next 2h.

jordan_sre: FYI we have one spare node in reserved-2 that can be attached quickly. Willing to swap if you want me to. Current agg: dedicated-g1 6/8 GPUs in use, avg token burn ~3.9/s, 95p latency 98ms.

sam_oncall: please do the swap if you can. Run `swapper swap --from=reserved-2 --to=dedicated-g1 --count=1` and then watch for token drop. I'll throttle the two background jobs now.

jordan_sre: running command now:
```
$ swapper swap --from=reserved-2 --to=dedicated-g1 --count=1
> request accepted, job id=swp-1792001301
```

ops-bot: autoscaler: scale-up triggered for dedicated-g1, +1 GPU (8 -> 9) at 1792001400. Reason: burst request by oncall. :white_check_mark:

sam_oncall: thanks — watching dashboards. If we see queue depth spike >500, fallback to model-quantized variant is allowed (policy: fallback-quantized). I'll ping infra to prep if that happens.

taylor_infra: quick note — if fallback kicks in, expect ~20% perf delta but saves burst tokens. I can also flip model-routing to `fallback-quantized` manually if autoswitch doesn't engage.

maria_dev: thanks all — left a short checklist in the runbook section. If anything urgent, call me but please escalate to platform lead if tokens hit <5. :pray:

sam_oncall: will do. pinged @taylor_infra if we need manual routing. starting 30m watch and logging any anomalies here.

ops-bot: alert muted for non-critical noise in this channel until 1792002050 (temporary suppression by sam_oncall).
